**Language:**

Copy [the table with all the text](https://github.com/MekoNix/CreateCalculated/blob/main/translations.csv), add a column with your language and attach the file here.

- Keep `{0}` and `{1}` as they are, the page puts numbers and names there.
- Where a row has forms separated by ` | `, such as `machine | machines`, write as many forms as your language needs and say how they are chosen.
- Item names come from the game, only the ones in the table are ours.
